body:
<!-- pr-reviewer: a3367c83409e0513a3f8ee55b1e0d3c48c9dff7a -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

What looks good
- The side choice is read from the part section at each cut level. It refuses by name for these cases: material on both sides, the side changes along the run or between levels, the tool beside the run overlaps the part, and an offset that folds (`contour_run_side.rs`, `material_side`, `clear_of_part`, `offset_run`).
- `clear_of_part` is an extra check. A run that ends at a wall is refused before the toolpath is made.
- The gouge and collision checks are not in the diff. They still judge the new pass.
- `generate.rs` changes only the open-run arm. The closed-ring code is not touched. Picks on the stock keep the old ride.
- No golden file and no snapshot PNG changed. No new dependency. No `unwrap`, `expect` or `panic!` in the new file (259 lines). The module has a provenance line. A decision file is present.
- The change in `a_mixed_pick_list_cuts_boundary_then_run_and_says_what_overlap_means` is correct. The test no longer expects a Gouge warning, because the tool now stands one radius off the wall. It now also checks that the path says "air side". This is a new expectation for new behaviour, not a weaker check. The pinning tests for a gouge that must be flagged are unchanged.

Results merged with main (local build, no runner used)
- Trial merge with main: clean.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-motion --lib contour_run_side`: 8 passed.
- Mutation check: I changed `offset_run(&run, d, !material_left)` to `material_left`. Three tests failed (`an_open_edge_is_cut_one_radius_off_on_its_air_side`, `stock_to_leave_moves_the_tool_further_off`, `conventional_travels_the_air_side_the_other_way`). I reverted the change.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test contour_open_side --test operations`: 2 passed; 119 passed, 6 ignored.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- I did not run the other motion and app suites. The author reports the quick gate green on this head.

Requested before merge
- None.

Questions / notes (not blocking)
- Two tests in `operations.rs` and `contour_open_side.rs` read the hand-built block. The author did not test the maintainer's `Block-w-slot.step` or a tilted setup. Please look at one real part in the GUI before the cut.
- The viewport still draws the picked run, not the offset ride. This is named in the PR body.
- `offset_run` is a copy of the one in `contour_open.rs`. The author plans a follow-up to share it.
- Overlap with PR #1769 on `selection.rs` can give a small conflict. Refresh at merge time.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
